dataset.name: FlyWire FAFB
dataset.license_verification: dataset-level public guidance checked; exact downloaded products still require verification

pilot.name: L1-Mi1/Tm3-T4 ON motion pathway core
pilot.minimum_synapses_source: Codex FAQ default threshold for FAFB

task.primary_metric: normalized difference in T4 response between opposite motion directions
task.metric_applicability_gate: requires verified mapping between visual position and the selected neuron/column input

required_products.purpose: directed pair connectivity and synapse counts

products_to_verify_before_import: column_assignment or another authoritative spatial/column mapping product
limitations: This core excludes known additional T4 inputs including Mi4, Mi9, C3, TmY15, and CT1.
Connectivity alone does not specify physiological synaptic signs, weights, delays, or neuron dynamics.
No biological root IDs, counts, or simulation results have been fabricated.
